$Comment: The crafting category. A prestige of a track in it clears the player's picks and offers each again preselected as the level comes back (Build Remember), unless the track says otherwise. A swap to one of a track's saved builds costs one copper bar (Loadouts.SwapCost, any wallet or item, an empty group for free); a respec is free unless a track or this file writes a Respec.Cost. A track keeps no saved builds until it writes Loadouts.Max.
